capabilities: Pull content types from Contentful and generate Obsidian templates from them
Pull content entries into notes organized by content type
Push edited notes back to Contentful as entry updates
Detect out-of-sync content and save a copy on conflict
Map entry fields to frontmatter properties
disambiguation: Not a website publishing tool; it syncs notes with the Contentful headless CMS, not Obsidian Publish.
extras: Creating new content, uploading images, and multi-locale support are listed as planned but not implemented; the plugin ignores RichText, ResourceLink, Link, Object and Location fields, and requires Markdown links instead of Wikilinks.
problem: Editing Contentful entries requires working in Contentful's own interface; Obsidian has no built-in way to edit CMS content locally.

relations.evidence: Contentful is a headless CMS that lets you create and deliver content to any platform.

summary: Contentful integration that pulls content types and entries from Contentful into Obsidian notes and pushes edits back.
